title: Magnifying glass with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='12' height='34' rx='6' fill='#c98a3a' transform='rotate(-45 68 68)'/>
  <rect x='64' y='64' width='4' height='30' rx='2' fill='#e8b25a' transform='rotate(-45 68 68)'/>
  <!-- rim of lens -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='30' fill='#9a6b2f'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#e8b25a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- glass -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='24' fill='#8fd9f0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#c8f2ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <path d='M28 30 Q34 22 44 21' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='40' r='4' fill='#1d4e6b'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='40' r='4' fill='#1d4e6b'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='39' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M33 52 Q42 60 51 52' fill='none' stroke='#1d4e6b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ff9fc0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='48' r='3' fill='#ff9fc0'/>
</svg>
